release.summary: The verse map grows. Named zoom steps (Here · The land · The Bible world, with − and +) and a locator. A marker's card shows the chapters naming its place around this verse, the full list by part of the Bible, and nearby places (#556). A Then · Today switch draws today's borders, countries and cities from Natural Earth (public domain) under the verse's places, and is described to screen readers. The controls sit below the site's name, and the Experimental tag is gone. #554's council polish ships inside #557.
release.leftOut: Nothing else was waiting: production was main 83b80fa5 (#559), released by another session at 18:50 UTC.

smoke.after: visibible.com/genesis/28/19 in headless Chrome at 1440×900 and 390×844: the map opens, Today draws today's cities (Damascus, Tel Aviv, Gaza City, …), the credit reads "Map: Natural Earth", there is no Experimental tag, Bethel's card opens, and Close the map closes it. No page errors. Nothing was painted.
